title: How I built 6 Income Sources That Generate $59,750 Per Month
summary: Breakdown of six income sources (real-estate commissions, rentals, YouTube ads, a course, mortgage paydown, coaching) and the years each took to build.

assertions.quote: I can work 12 hours a day seven days a week for 6 months straight and not earn a single penny

verdicts.note: That is how commission compensation works; agent income distributions are highly skewed.

In MLM commission-only selling, the share of participants receiving no payments at all exceeded 50% in 17 of the 27 disclosures that give the figure (range 3.6% to 90%), confirming that income can be zero; the uncapped upside is seen only in fractions of a percent.

assertions.quote: that instantly gave me an extra few thousand dollars every single month in rental income

verdicts.note: True at post-crash prices; at current price-to-rent ratios many markets cash-flow poorly, and management is not zero work.
Cheaply bought rentals do cash-flow, but repairs, vacancies and tenant management mean the income is not independent of the owner's labor.

Net rental yields after expenses averaged 6.1% in the lowest-price-tier cities against 2.4% in the highest, so cheaper rentals do produce more income per dollar, but the figures are index-level after paying for management, repairs and vacancy, and say nothing about the owner's labour.

assertions.quote: I now make on average of fourteen thousand dollars per month just from YouTube ad revenue

verdicts.note: Finance channels with large audiences do report this; it is the top tail, not the norm.

assertions.quote: he ended up making significantly more money selling courses on Amazon FBA than he was ever able to on Amazon FBA itself
a product like this especially a digital product is much easier to scale over anything else
the IRS classifies that is income

verdicts.note: Principal paydown builds equity and is effectively taxed because principal is not deductible, but it is illiquid and can be lost to price falls.

assertions.quote: don't rely on one source of income

verdicts.note: Diversification reduces income variance as long as the sources are not correlated.

assertions.quote: none of this was started overnight this is something that I have spent years building up to
